description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (optional for the current demo simulation). Advances simulation; inspect completedSteps/currentStep, not HTTP success. Next tool is simulation.metrics. Preserve operationId and original inputs on retries. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.step

expectedCheckpoint.description: Optional guard for new steps: omit to skip; a mismatched generation, currentStep or supplied metricId rejects the step with 409 without advancing.

operationId.description: Optional retry ID: omit for a new ID; reuse with identical inputs replays the saved result, while changed inputs, expired results or another run return 409.

name: simulation.step
title: Simulate Step
